Hi Julia —

Thanks again for your time on the call this morning. To get Acumen Lighting set up in our vendor master and enable PO issuance, we need a short packet of items from you. Can you and your finance team provide the following by EOD Friday (2026-09-17)?

- Legal entity name exactly as registered (including DBA if applicable)
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (or W-9 for US entities)
- Certificate of Formation / Articles of Incorporation
- ACH authorization (bank letter or voided check; we can accept the attached ACH mandate form filled and signed)
- Primary invoicing contact (name, email, phone) and PO routing email for automated PO delivery
- Remit address (if different from legal address)

I've attached our vendor onboarding template to make it easier — please complete and return with the documents. Once Accounting confirms the docs, we'll create the vendor code and issue the first PO. If anything is sensitive, feel free to send attachments to vendors-secure@redwood.com.

Appreciate a quick turnaround so we can hit the timeline for the September shipment.

Thanks,

Thanks for the forward — reviewed the packet. W-9 and Certificate look clean. ACH mandate is signed but we prefer a bank letter or a voided check for first-time ACH setups to reduce risk. Please ask Acumen for either: a) a bank letter on bank letterhead confirming account and routing numbers, or b) a scanned voided check.

If we get that, we can go ahead and: 1) create vendor in NetSuite, 2) set payment method to ACH, and 3) issue the PO. For net-30 terms: Procurement should confirm desired terms (markus) and Finance will run the credit/terms check; if approved I will set payment terms to Net 30 on the vendor record.
